name: 8-nen Ryoujoku II
source:
Born into ordinary families, love was supposed to bring them together. However, the crazy cogs of fate totally crush Kenta as he has his body and heart broken!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ036187.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

出生在普通家庭，爱情本应让他们走到一起。然而，命运的疯狂齿轮彻底击垮了健太，他的身体和心都碎了！
